question.text: Let $f(x)=\max \{x+|x|, x-[x]\}$, where $[x]$ stands for the greatest integer not greater than $x$. Then $\int_{-3}^3 f(x) d x$ has the value

solution.text: $\begin{aligned} & f(x)=\max \cdot\{x+|x|, x-[x]\}=\max \{x+|x|,\{x\}\} \\ & \int_{-3}^3 f(x) d x \\ & =\int_{-3}^0\{x\} d x+\int_0^3 2 x d x \\ & =\frac{3}{2}+9=\frac{21}{2}\end{aligned}$
